description.html: Gecko Nutrition Mango is a complete powdered diet made in Germany, developed for crested geckos and other fruit-eating reptiles. This variety has a rich tropical mango flavor that makes a refreshing, appealing meal for your geckos. The protein part of the food consists of high-quality black soldier fly larvae (Hermetia illucens), mealworms and crickets, which together make up 11% of the formula and provide essential amino acids. Mango (10%) is a source of beta-carotene, vitamin A and vitamin C, while banana (28%) contributes energy and natural sugars. The formula is further enriched with vitamins A, D3 and B-complex, as well as minerals such as manganese, iron and selenium, which support the immune system, bone health and reproductive function. Crude protein content is 25.4% and calcium 2%, providing an ideal nutrient ratio for a gecko's everyday diet.

Prepare a meal by mixing one part powder with two parts water (1:2 ratio) until you get an even, creamy texture. Offer the food in a shallow dish inside the terrarium in the evening, since geckos are mainly nocturnal. Feeding 2-3 evenings a week is recommended. Always remove uneaten food after 24 hours to keep the terrarium hygienic. As a complement to the complete diet, you can occasionally offer live insects dusted with calcium. Store the unopened pack in a cool, dry place.
Crested geckos and other fruit-eating reptiles.
